verdict.rationale: Alloy documents outbound webhooks that fire on asynchronous events such as a manual review occurring. They are signed, with exponential-backoff retries and auto-disable, so review outcomes and decisions can be pushed to an external system. Transaction-monitoring workflows can also generate investigations. Nothing documents an actual synchronization of investigations or cases with another case-management system. Missing for 10: a documented case/investigation API, inbound or two-way sync of investigation status and decisions, named case-management integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
